content.comment_body: Hello, I am new to [product_name] and have two questions regarding my project. 1) I am using [product_name] in a fire alarm system and need to ensure it remains operational, detecting any fault mode or loss of power. I am considering setting up an output normally closed, which switches to normally open in case of fault. Is this achievable? 2) I would like to display our company logo on the [product_name] display when idle. Is this possible? Thank you for your response. I look forward to learning from projects shared here.

For question 1: Yes, you can connect a HIGH block to a digital output. The output will stay active until [product_name] enters STOP mode or loses power. For question 2: The [product_name] display supports only text, not graphics. However, you can show a message with the lowest priority, like a company address or contact info.
Thank you, I'm enjoying experimenting with this system.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring options for monitoring status and using the display of [product_name] within a fire alarm system. Key insights highlight the device’s simplicity in implementing fault indication and its limitation to text-only display, which restricts branding with graphics. Users show interest in practical uses and report positive initial experiences, yet face constraints due to display capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects simple methods for monitoring system status, including both power and fault detection. They would like to present custom branding, such as a company logo, on the device display during idle periods, but are limited to text display only.
